text: Over the past few years I have been working closely with Community Planning, Transportation Services and Parks, Forestry and Recreation staff to improve the trail running along the Allen Road. As part of the effort to improve safety along the trail I am requesting the removal of a City owned fence, located on the east side of the Allen Road, between Glengrove Avenue and Glen Park Avenue. The fence currently separates a public walkway and a City-owned green space. Removing the fence will increase the usability of the greenspace in a park deficient area of the City, and will eliminate entrapment concerns. Other walkways along the Allen Road in Viewmount Park or Bennet Park do not have similar fencing and no concerns have been identified as a result.

North York Community Council: 1. Requested the Acting Director, Transportation Services, North York District to remove the City-owned fence located on the east side of the Allen Road, between Glengrove Avenue and Glen Park Avenue.
